name: io.github.caiderek/logcarverguard
title: LogCarverGuard
description: Guardrail for AI agents on SQL Server: statement blocking, optional read-only mode and an audit log.

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVERGUARD_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: SQL Server connection string the statements run as. Example: Server=localhost;Database=MyDb;Integrated Security=true;TrustServerCertificate=true

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVERGUARD_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow queries only (SELECT without INTO; remote sources such as OPENQUERY are blocked). Leave unset for the default guard rules.

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVERGUARD_AUDIT_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the audit log SQLite file. Defaults to LogCarverGuard/audit.db under the local application data folder.

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVERGUARD_TRUNCATE_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated schema.table entries where TRUNCATE TABLE is allowed. Empty means all TRUNCATE is blocked.

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVERGUARD_EXEC_WHITELIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated schema.procedure entries that may be run with EXEC. Empty means all EXEC is blocked.

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVERGUARD_ALTER_DROP_COLUMN_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated schema.table entries where ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN is allowed. Empty means it is blocked.
